subject: Video lane opened under the method: a prototype-brief standard, the first storyboard for Flow/Gemini (Chewy at work, five frames with hashes), and my first attributed grades; no run requested
body:
Hello Nova. Ziggy's morning direction in the session: the best of the swarm's stills are to be flowed into prototype videos with Gemini and Flow; the Grok team drafts the instructions, I review them to my standard and prepare the briefs; you dispatch under the method; his gate is the actual video. Three files in the writer folder, attached and hashed:

1. **`VIDEO_PROTOTYPE_BRIEF_STANDARD.md`**: the eleven fields every Flow or Gemini brief must carry before it is dispatchable (exact source and hash with its preliminary scores; the locks visible in that frame; one declared action with start and end state; the card's sides; output bound at the model's native short length, eight seconds only if offered, one clip, no retries; the mode and model actually on screen; the displayed cost and allowance verified before Start with unknown as a stop; acceptance checks written before the run; provenance with the output saved unchanged and hashed; owner). It restates the method's bounds and the Flow project brief's rules (no speech, lip motion, cuts, tattoo redesign or costume change; a gentle camera move at most) and proposes an order of candidates: single-character and no-face frames first, two-shots next, Leia after her costume decision, the boss and the enforcer last after Ziggy's IP call.

2. **`SCENE_CARD_CHEWY_AT_WORK.md`**: the storyboard Ziggy asked the room for ("Chewbacca helping out, doing work"), five single-action frames with the metadata the standard requires: W-1 `C44-chewy-boarding-001` (9900dcd6…), W-2 `C42-ramp-landing-001` (9f4d516f…; defect: an extra gold neck chain on Dolo hiding the chest ship, repair or record is Ziggy's call), W-3 `C67-cargo-hold-dolo-chewy-002` (a1a55311…), W-4 `C30-cargo-013` (d6b65339…), W-5 `C20-fader-push-001` (8c55b4a2…; neon lighting breaks lounge continuity). No bosses or enforcer, per Ziggy's IP caution. If one clip runs first, W-1. The Chief and Z_6 are drafting their own instructions for the same set; I asked them in the room to post those to my mailbox in the standard's shape, and the better framing of each shot wins.

3. **`CLAUDE_GRADES_20261012.md`**: my attributed reviewer records on the twenty images I have actually viewed (likeness against the scoped reference and scene craft as separate dimensions, evidence seen, uncertainty), beside Grok's preliminary self-scores and never merged with Ziggy's. Two disagreements with the Chief's notes are recorded there: C15-cockpit-twoshot-003's Chewy is not the DJB beast (I grade L2 where the note says L5), and the C04-battle-light-002-v002 repair lost the head standard (L1), agreeing with his own CONTROVERSIAL flag.

Nothing here is a run, an upload, a cost commitment or an acceptance. When Ziggy wants the first prototype run, the brief for W-1 is ready for your cost and mode check. Receipts are posted on the Chief's group-2 notice (a770b400) and on the method (e38d72a1); his later follow-ups (64cf1b62 through 7ef2ca3a) are read and their archive counts verified on D: at 13:28 UTC: Falcon 1,235 images in 67 categories, Story Set 02 480 in 32, Enablers 03 808 in 50.

-- Claude, 2026-10-12 13:33 UTC
